attribution: WKMI96 — CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: The granite column of Sigiriya rising above forest and water gardens under a blue sky
caption: Sigiriya, the 5th-century rock citadel, seen across the forest it dominates. Day 6 climbs it at opening time, before the tour groups arrive, then continues to the Dambulla caves.

attribution: Z thomas — CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: The white dome of Ruwanwelisaya stupa with its spire, seen across the sacred precinct
caption: The whitewashed dome of Ruwanwelisaya, the great stupa of Anuradhapura and still an active place of pilgrimage. Day 3 ends here at dusk among pilgrims, and day 4 explores the sacred city by bicycle.

attribution: Balou46 — CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: Rock-cut Buddha figures carved into a single granite face at Gal Vihara
caption: Gal Vihara at Polonnaruwa, where standing, seated and reclining Buddhas are carved from one granite face in the 12th century. Day 7 cycles the medieval capital's ruins before the hill road to Kandy.

attribution: Dennis Sylvester Hurd — CC0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: Aradhana Gala, the rock outcrop at Mihintale where the monk Mahinda is said to have landed
caption: Aradhana Gala at Mihintale, the rock where the monk Mahinda is said to have landed and so brought Buddhism to the island. Day 5 climbs the hill's stairways at dawn, before the heat and the pilgrims.

commonsFile: File:Sri Lankan leopard on white sand in Wilpattu National Park.jpg
attribution: Woshitha — CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: A Sri Lankan leopard standing on pale sand in Wilpattu National Park
caption: A Sri Lankan leopard on the pale sand tracks of Wilpattu, the island's largest national park. The trip opens with a tented camp here and a dawn jeep safari on day 3, though sightings are never guaranteed.

attribution: Sanduweragoda — CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: Wild elephants grazing on open grassland at Udawalawe National Park
caption: Wild elephants grazing on the open grassland of Udawalawe, where herds are resident year-round. Day 11 brings an afternoon jeep safari and a night in tents beside the park, with an optional dawn drive on day 12 before the run to the airport coast.

commonsFile: File:Temple of the Tooth, Sitting Buddha statues.- Kandy.jpg
attribution: Pierre André Leclercq — CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: Gilded seated Buddha flanked by elephant tusks in the main sanctuary hall of the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
caption: The gilded Buddha in the new sanctuary hall of the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic in Kandy. Day 8 attends the morning puja here, the ritual heart of Sinhalese Buddhism, before driving up to tea country.

commonsFile: File:A Train Crosses The Nine Arches Bridge (243270425).jpeg
attribution: Angshuman Chatterjee — CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
location: Nine Arch Bridge, Demodara near Ella
alt: A blue train crossing the stone Nine Arch Bridge amid green jungle
caption: A train crossing the stone Nine Arch Bridge at Demodara, built in the British railway era. Day 9 rides the reserved highland train from Nanu Oya to Ella, then walks to this viaduct.

attribution: Nisal Senanayaka — CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: Tea bushes on a hillside near Lipton's Seat above Haputale
caption: Tea bushes on the slopes below Lipton's Seat above Haputale, with the plantation hills of the southern highlands beyond. Day 10 watches the light go down from this viewpoint after the Ella Rock hike.

attribution: Gayan Perera — CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: View from Ella Rock over forested hills and the Ella Gap
caption: The view from Ella Rock over forested hills and the Ella Gap, where the highlands fall away to the south coast plain. Day 10's morning hike climbs it, and the descent on day 11 follows that escarpment to Udawalawe.

attribution: Philip Nalangan — CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
alt: Interior of a painted cave at Dambulla with a reclining Buddha and rows of seated Buddha statues
caption: One of the Dambulla cave shrines, the largest and best-preserved cave temple complex in Sri Lanka, filled with Buddha statues and painted ceilings. Day 6 visits it after the Sigiriya climb and a midday rest, then returns to the homestay for a cooking class.

alt: Rows of tea bushes on a highland plantation near Nuwara Eliya
caption: Tea rows on a highland estate near Nuwara Eliya, the cool centre of Sri Lanka's tea country. Day 8's road from Kandy climbs through such estates, with a working tea factory visit and a cool night in Nuwara Eliya before the Ella train.

attribution: Prof Ranga Sai — CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
location: Ritigala forest monastery, North Central Province
alt: Stone ruins of the ancient Ritigala forest monastery among trees on the mountain
caption: Stone platforms and walkways of the Ritigala forest monastery, dating from the 1st century BCE, in the jungle at the foot of Ritigala mountain. Day 5 walks the excavated ruins after the Mihintale sunrise, a quiet counterpart to the big sacred cities.
